Auto-discovery idea: Hspb1 expression and HDAC2-polyA_RNA spatial anticorrelation at chromatin spots¶

Rationale¶

Use the under-tested IF marker HDAC2 and linked Hspb1 expression to ask whether cell state is associated with local depletion of polyadenylated RNA signal at HDAC2-rich chromatin spots.

Data used¶

Use tracks.HDAC2 and tracks.polyA_RNA on the spot axis, grouped by spots.cell_id, and link each cell to Hspb1 expression in linked_adata.X.

Analysis sketch¶

For each cell, compute the within-cell Spearman correlation between HDAC2 and polyA_RNA across chromatin spots. The single reported parameter is the across-cell Spearman correlation between Hspb1 expression and this HDAC2-polyA_RNA concordance score.

Expected result¶

If Hspb1-high cells show stronger HDAC2-associated RNA depletion, Hspb1 should correlate negatively with the per-cell HDAC2-polyA_RNA spot-level correlation.

Validation checks¶

Confirm required fields, adequate cells and spots, finite correlations, a permutation p-value from shuffling Hspb1 labels, deterministic rerun, runtime budget, and a negative control replacing HDAC2 with total H3 or permuted HDAC2 values.

Exploration¶

The code agent can freely add cells below this point.

Critique and compact analysis plan¶

This subset contains only 9 cells, so the proposed across-cell association is necessarily exploratory and sensitive to single-cell leverage. I will first verify that the required track, cell, and linked RNA fields align, then compute one within-cell Spearman correlation between spot-level HDAC2 and polyA_RNA for each cell with sufficient finite spots. The main hypothesis test will use a deterministic permutation test that shuffles Hspb1 expression labels across cells and compares the observed across-cell Spearman rho to the resulting null distribution. I will also compute an H3/polyA_RNA per-cell concordance association as a lightweight negative-control comparison, recognizing that this does not prove biological specificity.

# Main compact statistical exploration for the Hspb1 / HDAC2-polyA_RNA anticorrelation idea
import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLBACKEND', 'Agg')
import time
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg', force=True)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from IPython.display import display, Image

start_time = time.time()
rng = np.random.default_rng(20260615)
min_spots_per_cell = 20
n_permutations = 999
result_path = RUN_OUTPUT_DIR / 'hspb1-expression-and-hdac2-polya-rna-spatial-ant-7e89d34844_result.csv'
figure_path = RUN_OUTPUT_DIR / 'hspb1-expression-and-hdac2-polya-rna-spatial-ant-7e89d34844_statistical_summary.png'

# Extract Hspb1 expression aligned to linked_adata obs_names.
gene = 'Hspb1'
gene_idx = list(adata.var_names).index(gene)
hspb1_values = adata.X[:, gene_idx]
if hasattr(hspb1_values, 'toarray'):
    hspb1_values = hspb1_values.toarray().ravel()
else:
    hspb1_values = np.asarray(hspb1_values).ravel()
hspb1_by_cell = pd.Series(hspb1_values.astype(float), index=pd.Index(map(str, adata.obs_names), name='cell_id'), name='hspb1_expr')

spot_df = cdata.spots[['cell_id']].copy()
spot_df['cell_id'] = spot_df['cell_id'].astype(str)
for col in ['HDAC2', 'polyA_RNA', 'H3']:
    spot_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(cdata.tracks[col], errors='coerce').to_numpy(dtype=float)

rows = []
for cell_id, group in spot_df.groupby('cell_id', observed=True, sort=True):
    cell_type = str(cdata.cells.loc[cell_id, 'cell_type']) if cell_id in cdata.cells.index else 'unknown'
    hspb1 = float(hspb1_by_cell.loc[cell_id]) if cell_id in hspb1_by_cell.index else np.nan
    finite_main = np.isfinite(group['HDAC2']) & np.isfinite(group['polyA_RNA'])
    finite_h3 = np.isfinite(group['H3']) & np.isfinite(group['polyA_RNA'])
    n_main = int(finite_main.sum())
    n_h3 = int(finite_h3.sum())
    if n_main >= min_spots_per_cell:
        rho_main = float(spearmanr(group.loc[finite_main, 'HDAC2'], group.loc[finite_main, 'polyA_RNA']).statistic)
    else:
        rho_main = np.nan
    if n_h3 >= min_spots_per_cell:
        rho_h3 = float(spearmanr(group.loc[finite_h3, 'H3'], group.loc[finite_h3, 'polyA_RNA']).statistic)
    else:
        rho_h3 = np.nan
    rows.append({
        'cell_id': cell_id,
        'cell_type': cell_type,
        'n_spots_total': int(len(group)),
        'n_finite_hdac2_polya': n_main,
        'n_finite_h3_polya': n_h3,
        'hspb1_expr': hspb1,
        'hdac2_polya_spearman_within_cell': rho_main,
        'h3_polya_spearman_within_cell_negative_control': rho_h3,
    })

per_cell = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(['cell_type', 'cell_id']).reset_index(drop=True)
valid = per_cell[np.isfinite(per_cell['hspb1_expr']) & np.isfinite(per_cell['hdac2_polya_spearman_within_cell'])].copy()
control_valid = per_cell[np.isfinite(per_cell['hspb1_expr']) & np.isfinite(per_cell['h3_polya_spearman_within_cell_negative_control'])].copy()

null_hypothesis = 'Across cells, Hspb1 expression is exchangeable with respect to the per-cell within-cell HDAC2 versus polyA_RNA Spearman concordance score; expected across-cell Spearman rho is not negative.'
alternative_hypothesis = 'Higher Hspb1 expression is associated with lower per-cell HDAC2-polyA_RNA concordance, i.e. a negative across-cell Spearman rho.'
test_method = f'one-sided deterministic permutation test of across-cell Spearman rho ({n_permutations} Hspb1-label shuffles; alternative=rho<0)'

if len(valid) >= 6 and valid['hspb1_expr'].nunique() >= 2 and valid['hdac2_polya_spearman_within_cell'].nunique() >= 2:
    observed = float(spearmanr(valid['hspb1_expr'], valid['hdac2_polya_spearman_within_cell']).statistic)
    null_distribution = np.empty(n_permutations, dtype=float)
    y = valid['hdac2_polya_spearman_within_cell'].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    x = valid['hspb1_expr'].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    for i in range(n_permutations):
        null_distribution[i] = float(spearmanr(rng.permutation(x), y).statistic)
    p_value = float((1 + np.sum(null_distribution <= observed)) / (n_permutations + 1))
    effect_size = observed
    hypothesis_test_status = 'pass'
    test_note = 'Permutation test completed with finite observed and null statistics.'
else:
    observed = float(valid['hdac2_polya_spearman_within_cell'].mean()) if len(valid) else 0.0
    null_distribution = np.array([0.0])
    p_value = 1.0
    effect_size = observed
    hypothesis_test_status = 'insufficient_data'
    test_note = 'Too few valid cells or too many tied values for the intended across-cell Spearman permutation test.'

if len(control_valid) >= 6 and control_valid['hspb1_expr'].nunique() >= 2 and control_valid['h3_polya_spearman_within_cell_negative_control'].nunique() >= 2:
    negative_control_rho = float(spearmanr(control_valid['hspb1_expr'], control_valid['h3_polya_spearman_within_cell_negative_control']).statistic)
else:
    negative_control_rho = np.nan

runtime_s = time.time() - start_time

# Repeat test-level fields in result_table so the CSV is self-contained.
result_table = per_cell.copy()
result_table['observed_statistic'] = observed
result_table['effect_size'] = effect_size
result_table['p_value'] = p_value
result_table['test_method'] = test_method
result_table['hypothesis_test_status'] = hypothesis_test_status
result_table['negative_control_h3_polya_across_cell_rho'] = negative_control_rho
result_table.to_csv(result_path, index=False)

analysis_summary = {
    'idea_id': IDEA.idea_id,
    'n_selected_cells': int(len(valid)),
    'n_rows': int(len(result_table)),
    'min_spots_per_cell': int(min_spots_per_cell),
    'n_permutations': int(n_permutations),
    'parameter_name': 'Across-cell Spearman rho between Hspb1 expression and per-cell HDAC2-polyA_RNA spot-level Spearman concordance',
    'parameter_value': float(observed),
    'observed_statistic': float(observed),
    'effect_size': float(effect_size),
    'p_value': float(p_value),
    'test_method': test_method,
    'null_hypothesis': null_hypothesis,
    'alternative_hypothesis': alternative_hypothesis,
    'hypothesis_test_status': hypothesis_test_status,
    'negative_control_h3_polya_across_cell_rho': None if not np.isfinite(negative_control_rho) else float(negative_control_rho),
    'expected_direction': 'negative',
    'runtime_seconds': float(runtime_s),
    'result_path': str(result_path),
    'figure_path': str(figure_path),
    'notes': [test_note, 'H3/polyA_RNA across-cell association is included only as a lightweight negative-control comparison.'],
}

# Statistical figure: observed group/association and null distribution.
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11.5, 4.5), facecolor='white', constrained_layout=True)
cell_types = list(valid['cell_type'].drop_duplicates())
colors = dict(zip(cell_types, plt.cm.Set2(np.linspace(0, 1, max(len(cell_types), 1)))))
for ct, sub in valid.groupby('cell_type', sort=True):
    axes[0].scatter(sub['hspb1_expr'], sub['hdac2_polya_spearman_within_cell'], s=58, label=f'{ct} (n={len(sub)})', color=colors.get(ct), edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.4)
if len(valid) >= 2:
    # Simple least-squares line for visual guidance only; Spearman/permutation is the reported test.
    coef = np.polyfit(valid['hspb1_expr'].to_numpy(float), valid['hdac2_polya_spearman_within_cell'].to_numpy(float), deg=1)
    xs = np.linspace(float(valid['hspb1_expr'].min()), float(valid['hspb1_expr'].max()), 100)
    axes[0].plot(xs, coef[0] * xs + coef[1], color='0.25', lw=1.5, label='linear guide')
axes[0].axhline(0, color='0.75', lw=1)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Hspb1 linked RNA expression (adata X units)')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Within-cell Spearman rho: HDAC2 vs polyA_RNA across spots')
axes[0].set_title('Cell-level association')
axes[0].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)

axes[1].hist(null_distribution, bins=min(25, max(5, int(np.sqrt(len(null_distribution))))), color='0.80', edgecolor='0.35', label='permuted Hspb1 labels')
axes[1].axvline(observed, color='#B22222', lw=2.2, label=f'observed rho={observed:.3f}')
axes[1].axvline(0, color='0.45', lw=1, ls='--')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Null Spearman rho')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Permutation count')
axes[1].set_title('One-sided permutation evidence')
annotation = (f'{test_method}\n'
              f'p={p_value:.3g}; effect size rho={effect_size:.3f}\n'
              f'n cells={len(valid)}; permutations={n_permutations}\n'
              f'H3 control rho={negative_control_rho:.3f}' if np.isfinite(negative_control_rho) else
              f'{test_method}\np={p_value:.3g}; effect size rho={effect_size:.3f}\nn cells={len(valid)}; permutations={n_permutations}')
axes[1].text(0.03, 0.97, annotation, transform=axes[1].transAxes, va='top', ha='left', fontsize=7.5, bbox={'boxstyle': 'round,pad=0.35', 'facecolor': 'white', 'edgecolor': '0.75', 'alpha': 0.95})
axes[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
fig.suptitle('Hspb1 expression vs HDAC2-polyA_RNA spatial anticorrelation at chromatin spots', fontsize=12)
fig.savefig(figure_path, dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight')
display(fig)
plt.close(fig)
display(Image(filename=str(figure_path)))

display(result_table)
print(json.dumps(analysis_summary, indent=2))

checks = {check: 'not_run' for check in IDEA.validation_checks}
notes = []
checks.setdefault('statistical_hypothesis_test', 'not_run')

def _check_keys(prefix):
    return [key for key in checks if key == prefix or key.startswith(prefix + ':')]

def _set_check(prefix, value):
    keys = _check_keys(prefix)
    if not keys:
        checks[prefix] = value
        return
    for key in keys:
        checks[key] = value

def _check_status(prefix):
    values = [checks[key] for key in _check_keys(prefix)]
    if not values:
        return None
    if 'fail' in values:
        return 'fail'
    if all(value == 'pass' for value in values):
        return 'pass'
    return values[0]

Final interpretation¶

Hypothesis. Higher Hspb1 RNA expression is associated with stronger anticorrelation between HDAC2 IF signal and polyA_RNA signal at chromatin spots, suggesting a cell-state-linked repressive IF/RNA spatial pattern.

Exploration. The notebook operationalized the idea as Spearman rho across cells between Hspb1 expression and the per-cell within-cell Spearman correlation of tracks.HDAC2 versus tracks.polyA_RNA across spots. using modalities if_tracks, cell_metadata, rna_expression in cell type(s) Granule, Bergmann, Purkinje. Required data fields checked: spots.cell_id, tracks.HDAC2, tracks.polyA_RNA, tracks.H3, cells.cell_type, linked_adata.X, linked_adata.var.Hspb1, linked_adata.obs_names.

Statistical evidence. U-Chrom runner status: Notebook verified. Test: one-sided deterministic permutation test of across-cell Spearman rho (999 Hspb1-label shuffles; alternative=rho<0). Observed statistic: 0.2263; effect size: 0.2263; parameter value: 0.2263; p-value: 0.745.

Conclusion. Not supported (Opposite direction). The observed effect points opposite to the expected direction and does not provide statistical support in this subset.

What verification means. Notebook verified means the run passed schema/data checks, produced finite numeric output, and included an explicit p-value/effect-size hypothesis test. It does not mean the biological hypothesis is automatically correct.

Checks passed. deterministic_rerun, finite_numeric_output, negative_control_or_permutation, required_fields_exist, runtime_under_budget, statistical_hypothesis_test.

Main caveat. Permutation test completed with finite observed and null statistics.
